notes: §9.1.13.10 1) '71' when a WRITE or REWRITE to a line sequential file has a record area character outside the implementor-defined set; unsuccessful, record area unchanged (cite.py --check OK §9.1.13.10 1)). Both WRITE entries (Write, WriteAdvancing) and the line-sequential REWRITE arm test RecordAreaOutsideLineCharacterSet before any stream traffic, and none writes the record area.
